snippet.title: Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition - 60FPS Update | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10003269

Return to an 80s vision of the future taking place on a bizarre open world island crawling with evil with Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition’s free 60FPS patch, available January 21 on PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles.

Play Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition with Ubisoft+ Classics, available as a standalone subscription, and included for PlayStation Plus Premium and PlayStation Plus Extra members.

#ps5 #ps5games #farcry3blooddragon 

Rated Mature
